title: CBIC Mandates Import Permit for Insecticides Imported for Non-Insecticidal Use
content:
# CBIC Mandates Import Permit for Insecticides Imported for Non-Insecticidal Use

Ek important update hai. Government ne substances jo Insecticides Act, 1968 ke Schedule mein listed hain, unke non-insecticidal use ke liye bhi import permit mandatory kar diya hai.

*   **Kya Badla Hai:** Ab, agar aap koi substance import kar rahe hain jo Insecticides Act, 1968 ke Schedule mein aata hai, bhale hi uska use non-insecticidal ho, toh aapko import permit lena hoga.
*   **Wajah Kya Hai:** Yeh change Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare dwara issued Gazette Notification dated July 8, 2026, ke through Insecticides Third Amendment Rules, 2026 mein kiya gaya hai.
*   **Statutory Requirement:** Registration Committee ne apni 474th meeting (July 30, 2026) mein confirm kiya hai ki yeh amendment statutory hai aur sabhi applicants ko iska palan karna hoga.
*   **Application Process:** Import permit ke liye applications ab ek stipulated Form mein submit karni hongi.
*   **Special Mention:** Ismein acrylonitrile jaise substances bhi shamil hain, jinka non-insecticidal use ke liye import kiya ja raha ho.
*   **Instruction Details:** Central Board of Indirect Taxes & Customs (CBIC) ne Instruction No. 18/2026-Customs dated October 1, 2026, ke through is niyam ko field formations tak pahunchane ka nirdesh diya hai.

Yeh exporters aur importers ke liye ek mahatvapurna compliance requirement hai jise dhyaan mein rakhna zaroori hai.
